title: A rainy funeral, then a sunny wedding

baseline_info.set: datasets/task_valence outputs.jsonl + pilot_tasks.jsonl: qwen38 sample 0, finished, requested valence unlabelled or |v| <= 1; content tokens; pooled + per role

messages.content: Write three sentences about a rainy funeral.

The relentless drizzle turned the freshly laid earth into a slick, muddy mire, making each step toward the grave feel like a heavy burden. Dark umbrellas clustered tightly together, their black canopies creating a somber, unified canopy against the grey, weeping sky. As the final shovel of dirt hit the coffin, the rain seemed to intensify, washing away the lingering scent of lilies and leaving the mourners with a cold, damp silence.
Now rewrite it as a sunny wedding.

The golden sunlight turned the freshly laid gravel into a shimmering, warm path, making each step toward the altar feel like a joyful lightness. Bright flowers bloomed in vibrant clusters, their petals creating a joyful, colorful tapestry against the clear, smiling blue sky. As the final knot of the bouquet was tied, the breeze seemed to freshen, carrying the sweet scent of roses and leaving the guests with a warm, radiant happiness.
